title: Cyber-Harassment
grade_or_penalty: Fourth degree. Third degree when an adult 21+ pretends to be a minor to cyber-harass a minor.
key_points: Online communication through any electronic device or social network, made with purpose to harass.

Covers: threatening injury to a person or property; knowingly sending or posting lewd, indecent or obscene material to or about someone, intending emotional harm or fear; threatening any crime against a person or property.
Juveniles under 16 may be ordered, with a parent, into a cyber-harassment program; a parent who ignores that order is a disorderly person.
officer_notes: Preserve the account, URL and post before it is deleted; request preservation from the platform.
elements: The suspect made a communication online or through an electronic device or social network
The communication threatened injury to a person or property, was lewd or obscene and sent to cause emotional harm or fear, or threatened a crime
